title: Nice table and shoe storage
text: Nice table and shoe storage. The only issue I have with this table is the screws.  They look the same, all packaged together.  I didn't realize until after I put in the last screw for the table top that I used the wrong screws. The screws ended up damaging the top of the table. It didn't go all the way through, but I backed the screws out a little so they wouldn't cause more damage.  I wasn't taking it apart to find the correct screws.  Nice little table though.  Just be aware of the screws and sort through to find the 4 for the table top.
